_comment: Official MMP Cup winners, one entry per cup year, from the engraved history plates. A cup year's golf champion comes from the summer it opens with (2025-26 golf = summer 2025), and its poker champion from the winter season that follows. This record wins over anything computed from season data; lib/champions.js fills in later cup years from complete seasons in golf.json / Supabase and poker.json. Names match players.json (Jaswant = Jas). An empty list with a note means no cup was awarded.
source: MMP Cup winner history plates (email from Neave, Nov 6 2026)
_notes: 2023-24 poker: the plates name Kerwin; poker.json's 2023-24 points standings (from the season spreadsheet) have Seymour top on 41 to Kerwin's 31. The plates are the official record.
